data.name: Claudetta
data.gender_notes: Claudetta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin 'claudus' meaning 'lame, slow' and 'et' meaning 'little, small'. Claudetta was a popular name for girls born into the Christian faith during the Middle Ages. The name Claudetta carries the meaning “Little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Claudetta usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to a child believed to be a blessing from God.
data.etymology: Claudetta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Claudetta total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: קלודטה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם נשים שמקורו בלטיני, ומשמעו רענן. השם מושאב מן הלטיני Clodia, ומקורו הוא בכן Claudius. השם קלודטה הוא שם נדיר בעברית. ישנן שתי גרסאות לאטימולוגיה של השם: האחת, היא שמקורו בכן Claudio, והשנייה, היא שמקורו בכן Clodia. במסורת הנוצרית, השם קלודטה נחשב לשם מאוד יפה ואציל. ישנן עדויות לשימוש בשם קלודטה בבאבלוניה הרומית, וכן בספרד. השם קלודטה נחשב גם לשם המסמל את האישיות היפה, התמימה והחברותית.

in_greek.name: Κλαυδέτα
in_greek.meaning: όνομα γυναικών με καταγωγή από τη λατινική
in_greek.long_meaning: όνομα γυναικών με καταγωγή από τη λατινική, και σημαίνει φωτεινός. Το όνομα Κλαυδέτα είναι σπάνιο στην ελληνική. Υπάρχουν δύο εκδοχές για την ατμολογία του ονόματος: η μια είναι ότι έχει καταγωγή από το όνομα Κλαύδιος, και η δεύτερη είναι ότι έχει καταγωγή από το όνομα Κλαδία. Στην χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Κλαυδέτα θεωρείται όνομα ωραίο και ευγενικό. Υπάρχουν στοιχεία για την χρήση του ονόματος Κλαυδέτα στην Ρώμη, και επίσης στην Ισπανία. Το όνομα Κλαυδέτα θεωρείται επίσης όνομα που συμβολίζει την ομορφιά, την αθωότητα και την φιλανθρωπία.

in_latin.name: Claudetta
in_latin.meaning: nomen femininum a Claudio deductum, significans clarus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen femininum a Claudio deductum, significans clarus. Origine nomen Claudetta derivatur a latino Claudius, qui significat clarus. In historia ecclesiae, nomen Claudetta erat nomen raro usitatum. In historia culturae christianae, nomen Claudetta erat nomen bonum et honestum. Nomen Claudetta significat claruit, claritas, et claritas animi. In cultura christiana, nomen Claudetta est nomen quod significat claritas animi et honestas.

in_english.name: Claudetta
in_english.meaning: feminine given name of Latin origin, meaning bright or clear
in_english.long_meaning: Feminine given name of Latin origin, meaning bright or clear, derived from the Latin name Claudius. The name Claudetta is a rare name in English-speaking cultures. In Christian tradition, the name Claudetta is considered a good and honest name. The name Claudetta means clarity, brightness, and a clear mind. In Christian culture, the name Claudetta is a name that signifies clarity of mind and honesty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Claudetta may have been popular during the Middle Ages due to its association with the saints Claudia and Clara, both of whom were known for their strength and endurance despite physical or personal challenges. The name may have also been embraced by parents as a reminder of the Christian virtue of patience, which was highly valued during this time.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Claudetta may be seen as a reminder of the strength and endurance that Christians should strive for in their own lives, drawing inspiration from the faithful lives of saints Claudia and Clara. The name may also serve as a reminder of the importance of patience and perseverance in the face of challenges or difficulties, reflecting the Christian belief in the power of God to bring good from suffering.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Claudetta: Little one with strength from God. Endowed with God's might.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Claudetta in Dublin, Ireland credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Claudetta, which means "Little one". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
